tables.name: ai_call_logs
tables.sql:
CREATE TABLE ai_call_logs (
	id INTEGER NOT NULL, 
	ts INTEGER NOT NULL, 
	provider VARCHAR(64) NOT NULL, 
	model VARCHAR(128) NOT NULL, 
	purpose VARCHAR(32) NOT NULL, 
	ok BOOLEAN NOT NULL, 
	latency_ms INTEGER NOT NULL, 
	prompt_tokens INTEGER NOT NULL, 
	completion_tokens INTEGER NOT NULL, 
	cost_usd FLOAT NOT NULL, 
	error VARCHAR(500) NOT NULL, 
	raw_text TEXT NOT NULL, 
	PRIMARY KEY (id)
)

tables.name: ai_providers
tables.sql:
CREATE TABLE ai_providers (
	id INTEGER NOT NULL, 
	name VARCHAR(64) NOT NULL, 
	protocol VARCHAR(32) NOT NULL, 
	base_url VARCHAR(255) NOT NULL, 
	api_key_enc TEXT NOT NULL, 
	model VARCHAR(128) NOT NULL, 
	temperature FLOAT NOT NULL, 
	max_tokens INTEGER NOT NULL, 
	reasoning_effort VARCHAR(16) NOT NULL, 
	timeout_sec INTEGER NOT NULL, 
	json_mode BOOLEAN NOT NULL, 
	enabled BOOLEAN NOT NULL, 
	priority INTEGER NOT NULL, 
	role VARCHAR(32) NOT NULL, 
	extra JSON, 
	created_at INTEGER NOT NULL, 
	updated_at INTEGER NOT NULL, 
	PRIMARY KEY (id), 
	UNIQUE (name)
)

tables.name: alert_logs
tables.sql:
CREATE TABLE alert_logs (
	id INTEGER NOT NULL, 
	ts INTEGER NOT NULL, 
	level VARCHAR(8) NOT NULL, 
	category VARCHAR(48) NOT NULL, 
	message TEXT NOT NULL, 
	channels VARCHAR(64) NOT NULL, 
	ok BOOLEAN NOT NULL, 
	error TEXT NOT NULL, 
	PRIMARY KEY (id)
)

tables.name: app_settings
tables.sql:
CREATE TABLE app_settings (
	"key" VARCHAR(64) NOT NULL, 
	value TEXT NOT NULL, 
	updated_at INTEGER NOT NULL, 
	PRIMARY KEY ("key")
)

tables.name: backup_jobs
tables.sql:
CREATE TABLE backup_jobs (
	id INTEGER NOT NULL, 
	ts INTEGER NOT NULL, 
	name VARCHAR(128) NOT NULL, 
	scope JSON, 
	file_path VARCHAR(400) NOT NULL, 
	size INTEGER NOT NULL, 
	sha256 VARCHAR(80) NOT NULL, 
	encrypted BOOLEAN NOT NULL, 
	status VARCHAR(16) NOT NULL, 
	message TEXT NOT NULL, 
	created_by VARCHAR(32) NOT NULL, 
	PRIMARY KEY (id)
)

tables.name: cooldowns
tables.sql:
CREATE TABLE cooldowns (
	symbol VARCHAR(32) NOT NULL, 
	until_ts INTEGER NOT NULL, 
	reason VARCHAR(120) NOT NULL, 
	kind VARCHAR(24) NOT NULL, 
	PRIMARY KEY (symbol)
)

tables.name: decision_journal
tables.sql:
CREATE TABLE decision_journal (
	id INTEGER NOT NULL, 
	ts INTEGER NOT NULL, 
	symbol VARCHAR(32) NOT NULL, 
	direction VARCHAR(8) NOT NULL, 
	confidence FLOAT NOT NULL, 
	entry_price FLOAT NOT NULL, 
	target_pct FLOAT NOT NULL, 
	reason TEXT NOT NULL, 
	snapshot JSON, 
	decision VARCHAR(16) NOT NULL,

	injected_experience_ids JSON, 
	status VARCHAR(16) NOT NULL, 
	outcome VARCHAR(16) NOT NULL, 
	actual_price FLOAT NOT NULL, 
	actual_pct FLOAT NOT NULL, 
	labeled_at INTEGER NOT NULL, 
	archived BOOLEAN NOT NULL, 
	mode VARCHAR(8) NOT NULL, 
	PRIMARY KEY (id)
)

tables.name: engine_events
tables.sql:
CREATE TABLE engine_events (

	payload JSON, 
	PRIMARY KEY (id)
)

tables.name: engine_state
tables.sql:
CREATE TABLE engine_state (
	"key" VARCHAR(64) NOT NULL, 
	value TEXT NOT NULL, 
	updated_at INTEGER NOT NULL, 
	PRIMARY KEY ("key")
)

tables.name: equity_points

	mode VARCHAR(8) NOT NULL,

)

tables.name: evolution_runs
tables.sql:
CREATE TABLE evolution_runs (
	id INTEGER NOT NULL, 
	ts INTEGER NOT NULL, 
	kind VARCHAR(24) NOT NULL, 
	input_count INTEGER NOT NULL,

	replaced INTEGER NOT NULL,

	PRIMARY KEY (id)
)

tables.name: experiences
tables.sql:
CREATE TABLE experiences (
	id INTEGER NOT NULL, 
	symbol VARCHAR(32) NOT NULL, 
	tags JSON, 
	scenario JSON, 
	lesson TEXT NOT NULL, 
	outcome VARCHAR(8) NOT NULL, 
	source_decision_id INTEGER NOT NULL, 
	source VARCHAR(24) NOT NULL, 
	hits INTEGER NOT NULL, 
	wins INTEGER NOT NULL, 
	losses INTEGER NOT NULL, 
	enabled BOOLEAN NOT NULL, 
	created_at INTEGER NOT NULL, 
	updated_at INTEGER NOT NULL, 
	PRIMARY KEY (id)
)

tables.name: mantras
tables.sql:
CREATE TABLE mantras (
	id INTEGER NOT NULL, 
	title VARCHAR(120) NOT NULL, 
	rule TEXT NOT NULL, 
	tags JSON, 
	category VARCHAR(32) NOT NULL, 
	source VARCHAR(32) NOT NULL, 
	confidence FLOAT NOT NULL, 
	health FLOAT NOT NULL, 
	hits INTEGER NOT NULL, 
	wins INTEGER NOT NULL, 
	losses INTEGER NOT NULL, 
	enabled BOOLEAN NOT NULL, 
	visible BOOLEAN NOT NULL,

	superseded_by INTEGER NOT NULL,

	created_at INTEGER NOT NULL, 
	updated_at INTEGER NOT NULL, 
	expires_at INTEGER NOT NULL, 
	PRIMARY KEY (id)
)

tables.name: news_items
tables.sql:
CREATE TABLE news_items (
	id INTEGER NOT NULL, 
	ts INTEGER NOT NULL, 
	source VARCHAR(48) NOT NULL, 
	title VARCHAR(400) NOT NULL, 
	url VARCHAR(800) NOT NULL, 
	summary TEXT NOT NULL, 
	sentiment FLOAT NOT NULL, 
	symbols JSON, 
	dedupe VARCHAR(64) NOT NULL, 
	raw JSON, 
	PRIMARY KEY (id), 
	CONSTRAINT uq_news_dedupe UNIQUE (dedupe)
)

tables.name: orders
tables.sql:
CREATE TABLE orders (
	id INTEGER NOT NULL, 
	ts INTEGER NOT NULL, 
	symbol VARCHAR(32) NOT NULL, 
	side VARCHAR(8) NOT NULL, 
	order_type VARCHAR(24) NOT NULL, 
	qty FLOAT NOT NULL, 
	price FLOAT NOT NULL, 
	status VARCHAR(24) NOT NULL, 
	purpose VARCHAR(24) NOT NULL, 
	client_order_id VARCHAR(64) NOT NULL, 
	exchange_order_id VARCHAR(64) NOT NULL, 
	reduce_only BOOLEAN NOT NULL, 
	mode VARCHAR(8) NOT NULL, 
	latency_ms INTEGER NOT NULL, 
	raw JSON, 
	PRIMARY KEY (id)
)

tables.name: positions
tables.sql:
CREATE TABLE positions (

	side VARCHAR(8) NOT NULL,

	fees FLOAT NOT NULL,

	ai_reason TEXT NOT NULL, 
	signal_score FLOAT NOT NULL,

)

)

tables.name: signals
tables.sql:

tables.name: trades
tables.sql:
CREATE TABLE trades (

	symbol VARCHAR(32) NOT NULL, 
	side VARCHAR(8) NOT NULL, 
	qty FLOAT NOT NULL, 
	entry_price FLOAT NOT NULL, 
	exit_price FLOAT NOT NULL, 
	leverage FLOAT NOT NULL, 
	notional FLOAT NOT NULL,

	fees FLOAT NOT NULL,

	closed_at INTEGER NOT NULL,

	ai_confidence FLOAT NOT NULL, 
	ai_reason TEXT NOT NULL, 
	signal_score FLOAT NOT NULL, 
	slippage_bps FLOAT NOT NULL,

tables.name: trading_symbols
